messages:
ryan-customer: Hey team — hitting a weird production issue with EventSource streams from the API. In Safari some clients get lots of partial chunks then an immediate disconnect, other browsers are fine.
ryan-customer: Looks correlated with our CDN prefetching and some 304s returning mid-stream. We see truncated payloads (missing final chunks) and a flurry of reconnects from the client. Billing shows duplicated short requests spiking.
ryan-customer: Repro steps we tried: 1) open SSE on Safari 16, 2) idle for ~12s so CDN may hit prefetch/cache, 3) server sends heartbeat + mid-response, 4) client receives a few incomplete events then EventSource 'error' and reconnect.
sarah-support: thanks — sorry about the hit. Can you paste the response headers for a failing stream and one that succeeds? also include the request URL and auth header masked. :eyes:
ryan-customer: failing headers (masked):
```
:method: GET
:status: 200
content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
transfer-encoding: chunked
cache-control: public, max-age=60
vary: Accept-Encoding, Cookie
x-cache: HIT
x-edge-prefetch: true
```
ryan-customer: when it fails we sometimes see a 304 in the middle of a keep-alive connection: server emits data then edge returns 304 for a prefetched range which seems to close/flush the stream.
sarah-support: that's helpful. Can you also share the EventSource client logs (console) and client network timing? any service worker in the page?
ryan-customer: No SW. Console shows "EventSource failed" then auto-reconnect. Network tab shows final event truncated, content-length missing (chunked).
sarah-support: I'll escalate to eng-runtime and SRE. Assigning to them and creating an incident. support-bot: Created INC-20250412-0187 — escalation to eng-runtime and eng-sre.
support-bot: Pager duty: tom-eng-runtime, jess-eng-sre.
tom-eng-runtime: thanks team — initial thought: CDNs can prefetch/cache and return 304s which conflict with open chunked streams. We expect SSE responses to be uncacheable and proxied as streaming chunked with no intermediate 304s. Two suspects: edge config (prefetch/aggregation) and our origin returning cache headers that allow stale/conditional responses.
tom-eng-runtime: quick mitigation: set cache-control: no-cache, no-transform and remove Vary: Cookie/Accept-Encoding for SSE endpoints; add header "Surrogate-Control: no-store" at edge. Also ensure the edge doesn't return 304 for open streams.
jess-eng-sre: +1. Also check our rate-limiter/proxy layer — if a 429 or backend retry happens mid-stream the proxy might inject a short response then close, causing client to reconnect and create duplicate billing meter events.
jess-eng-sre: can you grep logs for request_id / trace_id around the failure window? We need a trace id to follow the lifecycle across edge -> origin -> runtime.
ryan-customer: trace id: trace_7b9f2c. Attached small HAR of the session and the client console screenshot.
tom-eng-runtime: good. Can you try a curl repro from a mac host simulating Safari SSE? e.g.:
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/xxxxx"
```
This will show if the edge is chunking correctly. Also try forcing a cache bypass with `?cache_bust=1`.
ryan-customer: ran curl — I can reproduce partial chunks when edge x-cache: HIT. With `?cache_bust=1` stream stays open and completes.
tom-eng-runtime: that nails it — edge HIT path is interfering. We'll patch edge config to mark SSE endpoints as non-cacheable and disable prefetch for that route. We'll also publish an advisory for customers to set Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform.
jess-eng-sre: on the billing side, we'll dedupe short reconnects from the past 6 hours and flag for credits if duplicated token usage detected. Please DM billing with the incident id.
sarah-support: customer, we'll follow up with timeline and patch plan. Expect a config roll within 2 hours and a postmortem update. Sorry for the disruption. :thumbsup:
ryan-customer: appreciate it. One more ask — Safari clients using certain polyfills (event-source-polyfill/serviceworker) break more often. Any guidance on polyfills?
tom-eng-runtime: polyfills that buffer/replay chunks + service worker prefetching create backpressure. Where possible: avoid service worker interception on SSE routes; if polyfill is required prefer XHR/long-poll fallback or use the native EventSource when available. We'll add a note to the docs about SSE + SW gotchas.
support-bot: Update INC-20250412-0187: edge config change planned, billing dedupe in progress, customer notified.
sarah-support: closing loop for now — I'll reopen if you see recurrence after the edge change.
ryan-customer: confirmed after edge fix (rolled in staging) the stream remains stable. thanks everyone.
